messages.content:
Answer the question. Be concise. Reply with A or B only on the final line.

A randomly chosen part is defective with probability 1/3. Two tests are independent conditional on whether the part is defective. Test X is positive with probability 3/4 for defective parts and 1/4 otherwise. Test Y is positive with probability 2/3 for defective parts and 1/3 otherwise. X is positive and Y is negative. What is the probability the part is defective?

A. 3/7
B. 3/5
